title: dryopteris affinis subsp. paleaceolobata
intro: Dryopteris affinis subsp. paleaceolobata, commonly known as the pale-lobed buckler fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is a plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of the pale-lobed buckler fern include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in treating wounds, skin issues, and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
